title: Runner-up at the 2024 SFA Inter-School Competition
excerpt: SBPS finished runner-up at the 2024 SFA Inter-School Competition and was named best school in fencing, shooting and boxing.
author: Social Baluni Public School
body:
Social Baluni Public School finished as runner-up in the 2024 SFA Inter-School Competition.

### Awards

- Runners-up trophy
- Best school in fencing
- Best school in shooting
- Best school in boxing
- Rising school in sports

We thank the SFA organisers, judges and participating schools, and congratulate our students and coaches.
